title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust is the first protocol that measures trustworthiness in real-time during navigation, not just in simulation. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking provides objective, standardized metrics that ensure fair comparisons across different navigation systems and platforms. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust integrates sensor fusion and uncertainty quantification, giving real-world reliability that benchmarks can't replicate. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Without benchmarking, NavTrust is just another proprietary metric with no way to validate its claims against industry standards. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Benchmarking ensures transparency and scalability — NavTrust needs that to be taken seriously. (4 sec)
